result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: restaurant metadata text appears overlapped and hard to read.

issues.description: In the first “Popular right now” restaurant card, the metadata line under “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” appears visually overlapped/garbled around the delivery time and delivery text, making it difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Check the layout constraints for the restaurant metadata row. Ensure the delivery time, delivery fee, separator, and cuisine label have proper spacing and do not render on top of each other, especially on narrow screens.
